model_organism.citation: Hypomaturation enamel defects in Klk4 knockout/LacZ knockin mice (PMID: 19578120)
phenotypes: Klk4 replaced by lacZ reporter (null allele); beta-galactosidase expressed in maturation-stage ameloblasts only
Retained enamel proteins in maturation-stage enamel
Enamel normal in thickness with decussating rods
Enamel rapidly abraded after weaning despite soft chow
Enamel fractured readily; crystallites failed to interlock
Delayed crystal maturation
Hypomaturation amelogenesis imperfecta

model_organism.citation: Maturation stage enamel malformations in Amtn and Klk4 null mice (PMID: 26620968)
phenotypes: Klk4-/- mice healthy and fertile with no abnormalities except in enamel
Chalky-white, chipped mandibular incisors
Enamel thickness, volume and rod decussation unchanged
Enamel maturation onset mesial to the normal position
Reduced enamel mineral density (2.5 vs 3.1 gHA/cm3 in wild type)
Reduced Knoop hardness at all enamel levels
Amtn-/-Klk4-/- double null outer enamel softer than in either single null
model_organism.significance: significantly reduced mineral density and hardness (p-values not given in abstract)

model_organism.citation: Effect of kallikrein 4 loss on enamel mineralization: comparison with mice lacking matrix metalloproteinase 20 (PMID: 21454549)
phenotypes: Enamel normal in thickness and layer/rod organization
Developmental defect in enamel rods near the dentinoenamel junction
Normal mineralization to early maturation, then retention and gain of protein
Enamel unable to mature beyond 85% mineral by weight
Hard outer enamel but soft, protein-rich inner enamel
Overall mineral acquisition rate reduced by 25%

model_organism.citation: Enamel proteins and proteases in Mmp20 and Klk4 null and double-null mice (PMID: 22243248)
phenotypes: Retained organic matrix in Klk4 null enamel
Secretory-stage matrix in Klk4 null identical to wild type
Klk4 expression normal in Mmp20 null background, and a 40-kDa protease induced in Mmp20 null maturation stage
Mmp20/Klk4 double nulls retained more residual matrix than either single null
Limited functional redundancy between MMP20 and KLK4

model_organism.citation: Relationships between protein and mineral during enamel development in normal and genetically altered mice (PMID: 22243238)
phenotypes: Normal mineral acquisition up to early maturation in Klk4 null mice
Input of new volatiles (protein) in mid to late maturation
Final mineralization slowed below normal levels

biological.citation: Direct and indirect mechanisms of KLK4 inhibition revealed by structure and dynamics (PMID: 27767076)
biological.summary: X-ray crystal structures of KLK4 in complex with sunflower trypsin inhibitor-1 (SFTI-1) and an engineered SFTI-1 derivative were solved at ~1 Å resolution, and a structure with bound nickel was also solved. Together with MD simulations, they reveal a dynamic pathway between the metal-binding exosite and the active site, supporting an allosteric mode of inhibition.

biological.citation: Kallikrein-related peptidase 4 induces cancer-associated fibroblast features in prostate-derived stromal cells (PMID: 28510269)
biological.summary: KLK4 is highly expressed in prostate epithelium of PIN and malignant lesions, especially at the peristromal interface. In WPMY1 stromal cells, KLK4 activated PAR-1 and induced CAF-like features (increased αSMA, ESR1, SFRP1, FGF1, TAGLN, LOX, IL8, VEGFA). It also drove proliferation and secretome changes that stimulated HUVEC proliferation in a VEGFA-dependent manner.

biological.citation: Substrates of the prostate-specific serine protease prostase/KLK4 defined by positional-scanning peptide libraries (PMID: 15389820)
biological.summary: Recombinant KLK4 is a trypsin-like serine protease that prefers P1-Arg. Its predicted and tested substrates include pro-PSA/KLK3, which it activates, and IGFBP family members, which it degrades. Database searches also flagged PTHrP and BMP family members as candidate substrates. KLK4 is expressed in androgen-regulated prostate epithelium.

biological.citation: Characterization of KLK4 expression and detection of KLK4-specific antibody in prostate cancer patient sera (PMID: 12370833)
biological.summary: KLK4 mRNA and protein are expressed specifically in normal prostate and in primary and metastatic prostate tumors, with low-level mRNA in adrenal gland, salivary gland and thyroid. Prostate cancer patient sera contain antibodies that bind recombinant KLK4.

biological.citation: KLK4 Silencing Inhibits the Growth of Chromophobe Renal Cell Carcinoma through ERK/AKT Signaling Pathway (PMID: 36260980)
biological.summary: KLK4 is upregulated in kidney chromophobe tumors and cell lines. KLK4 knockdown reduced proliferation, colony formation, migration, invasion and EMT, and slowed xenograft tumor growth in nude mice, with lower Ki-67 and CD105. The abstract reports that AKT and ERK phosphorylation were enhanced with KLK4 silencing and concludes KLK4 acts via ERK/AKT signaling.

biological.citation: KLK4 silencing inhibits the growth of oral squamous cell carcinoma through Wnt/β-catenin signaling pathway (PMID: 28150891)
biological.summary: KLK4 is highly expressed in OSCC. Silencing it inhibited proliferation and colony formation, caused cell cycle arrest and enhanced apoptosis (cleaved PARP, cleaved caspase-3 and Bax up, Bcl-2 down). It also reduced Wnt1, β-catenin, p-GSK-3β, cyclin D1 and c-myc, and a Wnt/β-catenin activator reversed the effects, placing KLK4 upstream of Wnt/β-catenin signaling.

biological.citation: Maturation stage enamel malformations in Amtn and Klk4 null mice (PMID: 26620968)
biological.summary: Klk4-/- mice have chalky, chipped incisors with reduced enamel mineral density (2.5 vs 3.1 gHA/cm3 in wild type) and reduced hardness at all enamel levels. Phenotypes of Amtn-/- and Klk4-/- mice differ, and the double knockout is additive, so AMTN and KLK4 function independently and both are needed for enamel maturation.
biological.significance: significantly reduced mineral density and hardness

biological.citation: Novel MMP20 and KLK4 Mutations in Amelogenesis Imperfecta (PMID: 26124219)
biological.summary: Whole exome sequencing of consanguineous families identified a homozygous KLK4 frameshift (c.620_621delCT, p.Ser207Trpfs*38) causing recessive hypomaturation amelogenesis imperfecta. The mutant KLK4 was degraded intracellularly and was inactive.

biological.citation: Molecular and circadian controls of ameloblasts (PMID: 22243224)
biological.summary: In HAT-7 ameloblast cells, Klk4 (a maturation-stage marker) mRNA was upregulated by overexpression of both Dlx3 and Runx2. Amelx and Enam were instead down-regulated by Runx2 and up-regulated by Dlx3. Clock genes also influenced the rhythmic expression of ameloblast-specific genes and of Runx2.

biological.citation: NaF reduces KLK4 expression by decreasing Foxo1/Runx2 expression in LS8 cells (PMID: 34781073)
biological.summary: In LS8 ameloblast-like cells, NaF decreased Runx2 dose- and time-dependently. Runx2 knockdown markedly decreased KLK4 expression under NaF, and Foxo1 positively regulated Runx2, so a Foxo1/Runx2/KLK4 axis underlies low KLK4 in fluoride exposure.
